# CANON v0 results (generated by scripts/canon_eval.py)

Design frozen in `docs/canon_design.md` (sections 1-9 before any run; section 10 after the pre-registered attribution on validation blocks). Corrected feature group: **bytes** only (the only driver). Attacks are scripted attack-like workloads, not real attacks. All numbers computed; nothing hard-coded.

## Context estimator c-hat

- Accuracy on the main test blocks: 1.000; on the replicate test blocks: 1.000.
- Per-profile recall (main test): X25519MLKEM768/ecdsa_p256/leaf=1.00, X25519MLKEM768/ecdsa_p256/leaf_int=1.00, X25519MLKEM768/mldsa44/leaf_int=1.00, X25519MLKEM768/mldsa65/leaf=1.00, X25519MLKEM768/mldsa65/leaf_int=1.00, X25519MLKEM768/mldsa87/leaf_int=1.00, X25519/ecdsa_p256/leaf=1.00, X25519/ecdsa_p256/leaf_int=1.00, X25519/mldsa44/leaf_int=1.00, X25519/mldsa65/leaf=1.00, X25519/mldsa65/leaf_int=1.00, X25519/mldsa87/leaf_int=1.00, mlkem768/ecdsa_p256/leaf=1.00, mlkem768/ecdsa_p256/leaf_int=1.00, mlkem768/mldsa44/leaf_int=1.00, mlkem768/mldsa65/leaf=1.00, mlkem768/mldsa65/leaf_int=1.00, mlkem768/mldsa87/leaf_int=1.00.

## Post-hoc additions (recorded in `docs/canon_design.md` change log; NOT part of the frozen v0 design)

- **canon_bs_k*** = CANON-B *split*: the first k/2 calibration flows fit the shift, the last k/2 set the conformal threshold (k in [60, 100, 120]; k=30 would give n=15 and a vacuous threshold, so it is skipped). Reason: v0 used the same k flows for both, which voids the conformal guarantee.
- **canon_a2_*** = CANON-A2, EXPLORATORY and post-hoc: the default 40 B per-certificate overhead is replaced by the measured value from the lab's own certificates (`results/cert_overhead.csv`). CANON-A is unchanged.
- AE re-run with max_iter=2000 (was 500). AE fits not converged in this script: 0/5.

CANON-B AUROC is computed on the margin (score minus the per-context threshold). With k=10 the conformal threshold is +inf (rank 11 > 10), so nothing is flagged: FPR = TPR = 0 and AUROC = 0.5 by construction.

## Confirmation on the replicate run (CANON fitted on the main run, nothing refitted)

- CIs overlap in 532/576 (profile, detector, method, metric) cells (fpr, tpr_all, auroc); largest absolute difference 0.158.

## Caveats

- Scripted workloads, one machine, one cipher suite, 18 profiles = 18 'doses'; time-blocked splits inside one pcap.
- The context estimator needs labelled flows of every context, so 'zero PQ training data' holds for the CANON-A correction rule only; the TRUE-context variants isolate that.
- CANON-A uses default size-model overheads; byte deltas are off by ~34 B for leaf_int and 170-370 B for leaf profiles.
- CANON-B uses the same k flows for the shift and for tau (mildly optimistic) and corrects bytes only.
- Bootstrap CIs resample flows and ignore pcap-level variance.
